Widgetry Merit Badge

Merit Badge Requirements

The requirements will be fed dynamically using the scout book integration

NOTE: The official merit badge pamphlets are now free and downloadable HERE
1. Do the following:
  • (a) Explain to your counselor the most likely hazards you may encounter while working with widgets.
    Resources: Widget Safety Tips (video)
    Widget Dust and Your Eyes (website)
  • (b) Show that you know first aid for the injuries that could occur while widgeting.
2. Describe the three classes of widget and give an example of each.
